headline: Australian Canola Farmers Consider Legal Action After Widespread Crop Failures
summary: Farmers in Australia's main canola-growing region are weighing legal action after experiencing widespread crop failures across multiple seed varieties, resulting in major financial losses.
why: Australia is a major exporter of canola; unexpected crop failures directly impact global oilseed trade balances and local agricultural income.

impacts.name: Australian Agriculture
impacts.why: Canola crop losses reduce regional harvest yields and farming revenue.
